_note: Who stands where in each scene (ScenePeople). scene is the scene's SCENE_ID; pos is where the person's feet are, in picture pixels, on open floor. show_if / hide_if are MissionTracker conditions checked when the scene opens, so a person never vanishes while Amelia is talking to them. look: placeholder draws a stand-in figure (PlaceholderPerson) until the character's art exists; none means the scene already draws them (Evelyn in Florist.tscn's script). Talking counts as meeting the character (talked_to), and sets flag when one is given. speaker names the portrait (only Amelia, Oliver and Evelyn have portraits so far). Lines are placeholders until the real words are added; Evelyn stays guarded, as her secret waits for Mission 10.

lines: You came! Sit anywhere you like. The window seats get the best light in the afternoon.
First coffee for new neighbours is on the house. Welcome to Evervale.

lines.text: Amelia! How are you both settling in?
If anything in the house needs fixing, just tell me. It stood empty for a long time.
